confidence_tiers.insufficient: sample below the metric's registry minimum (min_bouts / min_rounds / min_seconds); value is null when there is no denominator
confidence_tiers.low: minimum met but sample_bouts < 3 (result metrics) or sample_seconds < 1800 (rate metrics)

data.as_of_semantics: as_of_date is exclusive: the snapshot dated D contains bouts with event_date < D, so a bout fought on D is excluded by the snapshot dated D. ?as_of=D resolves to the latest stored snapshot with as_of_date <= D, which therefore never contains a bout fought on or after D.
